Hours of Solomon

      
A grimoire you work through: the hours and their angels, the instruments to make, the rites they unlock, and the spirits of the Greater and Lesser Keys. Tell the app who you are and where you are, and it will follow the hours for you.

    

    

      

      

      

        Your place
        
Your date of birth is kept with your profile; every date the app gives is counted from today. Planetary hours start at your local sunrise and sunset, so the app needs to know roughly where you are.
